## Who is Pravin G?

Pravin G is a WordPress Developer and engineer from Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Electronics and Communication Engineering from SNS College of Technology (2017–2021). He specializes in custom WordPress solutions, reusable PHP templates, compiled React component integrations, and automated business workflows connecting websites with SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, GitLab, YouTrack, and AWS.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. WordPress Development & Custom Plugins
Pravin develops and maintains high-performance business and SaaS websites. He writes custom plugins and clean, reusable PHP templates for complex industry and product pages.

### 2. React & Frontend Integration
Pravin integrates compiled React components into WordPress platforms, developing interactive JavaScript interfaces, custom sliders, SVG animations, and exploring GSAP and ScrollTrigger.

### 3. Enterprise Workflow Automation
Pravin architects Power Automate workflows connecting SharePoint lists, GitLab project-member metadata, YouTrack resource assignments, and Microsoft Teams notifications with Adaptive Cards.

### 4. Cloud & API Integrations
Pravin builds cloud integrations utilizing AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Amazon S3, HTTP APIs, and webhooks for automated data operations.

### 5. Technical SEO & Schema Markup
Implementation of meta titles, JSON-LD structured data, FAQ schema, sitemaps, URL architecture, and diagnosing client-side React rendering indexing issues.
